categories.main_business_segments: Tus-Design Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: comprehensive design and consulting services covering planning, engineering design, consulting, and testing; architectural engineering general contracting (EPC) with a focus on design-led project management; dual-carbon new energy business including energy station construction, distributed photovoltaic power stations, energy-saving renovations, and energy management contracts; and digital technology services emphasizing AI and digital transformation in engineering design and smart building operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as BIM (Building Information Modeling), AI-driven design automation, digital twin modeling, and green low-carbon building technologies. It integrates digital and AI technologies into the entire design and construction lifecycle, emphasizing smart construction, energy efficiency, and carbon neutrality. The EPC projects utilize design-led integrated management, combining industrialized, digital, and intelligent construction methods. The new energy segment focuses on photovoltaic integration, wind power, and energy-saving technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tus-Design serves a diverse customer base including government entities, urban infrastructure projects, real estate developers, industrial manufacturers, and energy sector clients. Key markets include urban rail transit, industrial parks, cultural and educational institutions, healthcare and elderly care facilities, boutique hotels, and new energy projects. The company also targets emerging markets in green building, smart city development, and urban renewal initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with a strong presence in Jiangsu Province, especially Suzhou, and expanding activities in the Yangtze River Delta, Greater Bay Area, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Chengdu-Chongqing, and Shaanxi regions. It also has subsidiaries and projects in Shenzhen, Shanghai, and other major Chinese cities. There is no significant international geographic coverage reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tus-Design operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction and urban development supply chain. It provides design consulting, engineering management, and EPC contracting services, acting as a key integrator between project planning, design, construction, and operation phases. The company also engages in energy system integration and smart operation services, positioning itself as a technology and service provider rather than a raw material supplier or construction labor contractor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on green low-carbon development, digital transformation, and AI integration to drive innovation in urban construction and energy efficiency. R&D priorities include green smart building engineering consulting, digital twin technology, AI-assisted design automation, energy-saving technologies, and smart operation platforms. It actively participates in national and regional standards development and invests in AI research centers to enhance design efficiency and develop new business models aligned with China's dual-carbon goals and smart city initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based service contracts including design consulting fees, engineering general contracting (EPC) project revenues, and new energy project construction and management fees. The company also earns income from digital technology solutions and smart operation services. Revenue is recognized based on contract progress and delivery of services, with no significant reliance on product sales or recurring subscription models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tus-Design is positioned as a leading urban construction technology and service provider in China, especially strong in green building, smart city, and EPC integrated services. It competes with large state-owned design institutes and private engineering firms, with a competitive edge in technology integration, AI application, and comprehensive service offerings. The company holds a strong market position in Jiangsu Province and is expanding nationally, recognized for award-winning projects and innovation leadership in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tus-Design reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, a 25.79% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 99.44 million, reflecting challenges from industry downturns and impairment provisions. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.04 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.10 billion. Despite recent financial pressures, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D and strategic growth areas, aiming for recovery and sustainable development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tus-Design emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop integrated service capability across the entire construction lifecycle, combining advanced digital technologies, AI, and green low-carbon solutions. Its unique value lies in the integration of design-led EPC management, innovative smart building and energy solutions, and strong expertise in urban renewal and new energy projects. The company’s award-winning projects and deep industry knowledge provide differentiated, high-quality, and sustainable solutions that align with national strategies for green development and smart urbanization.
